name: Hametsu no Mars
source:
In 2016 a manned probe send from the Earth to invistigate Mars explodes in the Earth atmosphere and fragments which contain a dna sample of what is thought as a trace to possible Mars inhabitants fells on Japan.

That causes mutations all over Japan. People who are infected by that "virus" are called the Iseki-jin (relic persons). The AAST is founded, obtaining the cooperation of structure Doctor Hiroshi Hyuga they develop a suit, "Mars", as a trump card against the relic persons.

The carrier of the suit obtains super powers but only a few people, who are dna compatible with the suit are suited to wear it. Takeru, the son of the doctor was the first person who was able to wear it.

When the fragment which fell to Earth is being transported to a laboratory in the USA for an analyze the trasnport is being attacked by the relic persons, now Takeru has to fight and defend it for a final solution in this incident.

[from [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=3225]AniDB.com[/url]]
translation:
2016年，地球发射了一艘载人探测器前往火星调查，却在返回时于地球大气层内爆炸。残骸中含有一份DNA样本，被认为可能是火星居民曾经存在的痕迹；这些碎片随后坠落在日本各地。

这场事故在日本各处引发突变。感染那种“病毒”的人被称作“遗迹人”。为应对他们，人类成立了AAST，并在日向博士的协助下开发出名为“玛尔斯”的战斗服，将其视为对抗遗迹人的王牌。

穿上战斗服的人可以获得超能力，但只有极少数DNA与之相容的人能够驾驭它。博士的儿子日向武，是第一个成功穿上“玛尔斯”的人。

后来，人们准备将坠落地球的碎片运往美国的实验室进行分析，运输队却遭到遗迹人袭击。为了让这场灾难得到最终解决，武必须投入战斗，守住碎片。
